name: Pro Diff and Version History
description: Virtualised unified/split diff with Shiki highlighting, word-level changes, folded context, line comments, and a version timeline with named versions and restore. Handles 50k-line files.

props.name: language
props.description: Shiki language id (ts, tsx, json, yaml, sql, md...); text disables highlighting

props.name: contextLines
props.description: Unchanged lines kept around each change before folding

props.name: wordDiff
props.description: Highlight changed words inside modified lines

props.name: comments
props.description: { id, side: 'old'|'new', line, author, body, createdAt } threads anchored to lines

props.name: onAddComment
props.description: Enables the per-line comment composer; throw to show an error

props.name: versions
props.description: ProVersionHistory: { id, name?, createdAt, author, content, message? }

props.name: onRename
props.description: ProVersionHistory: name or rename a version (named versions are starred and filterable)

usage: Use ProDiffViewer for code review, config changes and document revisions; use ProVersionHistory to browse saved versions, compare any two (Compare from), name milestones and restore. Keyboard: j/k (or n/p) jump between changes when the diff has focus; Up/Down/Home/End move through the timeline; Ctrl+Enter posts a comment. Files over 4000 lines are highlighted lazily per visible line.
